# Captured compiler owners at actual optional sites

Updated: 2026-10-20 19:22 CEST.
Proof checkpoint: `db94389dc115be902e14e9c8f1bdf5b87af0e1f3`.
Start: `bfce6c47157e1178c53e622b637e9464b860dc99`.
Main: `9769fe3e921d63836a0be337f19edd3c601f076e`.

## Proved statement

An actual physically checked prefix starts at an unbound node request.
It reaches an optional-binder instruction at a particular checked state.
The prefix now derives a captured node-query owner for that same instruction.
The caller supplies no owner, semantic return or future completion.

The receipt retains the actual earlier query prefix, query inputs, lookup
and demand. It retains the same full suspended and evaluating captured
cells in the actual lookup and demand states. It retains the actual compiler-entry state, recursive
branch, operand identities, domain entry and checked enter instruction.
The entered child request returns the exact optional body at the exact
optional state. The full finish continuation remains equal to the observed
continuation. The prefix length is the earlier query length plus two steps
plus the entered child length.

`SourceCurrentNativeOwnedGeneration.execute` applies this result to bounded
node-request execution. A selected full Mu cell is the exact initial cell
or has an actual generating optional instruction. That same instruction
retains its captured owner, done or pending nested call, checked advance,
count/resume equation, physical and issued intervals, generated source build,
Context and rooted writer. One stopping-generation application supplies the
tuple. Owner recovery consumes its same returned prefix.

## Proof structure

| Module | Public declarations | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SourceCurrentNativeOptionalPrefix` | `bound_optional_cases` | Split a bound prefix into the unfinished inner call or its actual return and outer prefix. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeQueryOptionalPrefix` | `node`, `edge` | Recover the direct original compiler or same captured running compiler and finish continuation. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeMuOptionalPrefix` | `trace` | Recover the actual domain entry and nested child site or own optional site. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeOptionalOwnerReceipt` | `Owner`, `bind`, `prepend` | State the correlated receipt and transport it through actual code and prefixes. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeWalkOptionalPrefix` | `cut` | Retain the original indexed child, completed earlier calls and actual prefix to that child. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeEdgeOptionalPrefix` | `edge_body` | Retain the actual accepted constraint allocation and original ordered child request. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeCompilerOptionalPrefix` | `node` | Classify the actual recursive, nested node or nested edge compiler prefix. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeOptionalOwner` | `request` | Derive the captured owner by strong induction on actual prefix length. |
| `SourceCurrentNativeOwnedGeneration` | `execute` | Attach that owner to the same selected generated Mu operation. |

The induction handles node and edge requests together. Each compiler prefix
is shorter than its enclosing query prefix. A selected child prefix can
equal its compiler prefix, as in reset and swap. It remains shorter than
the enclosing query prefix. An unresolved request key excludes a pair of
complete operand identities. Thus the direct-query branch cannot own a Mu
instruction itself. It can transport a derived nested owner.

The checked edge proof uses the actual constraint-field loads and accepted
allocation result. It retains the exact operation cache and child zip index.
It does not substitute the older eager edge compiler for the checked body.

## Constructed example

The example performs two actual source builds from the empty heap. Their
results are distinct raw Mu operands. It proves both actual build equations,
the recursive compiler decision, semantic heap facts and operand availability.
Four checked native steps reach the compiler's own optional instruction:
root query, domain entry, child query and child finish.

One owner theorem application consumes that same trace, pair, body, state
and continuation. The optional instruction has not executed. The owner has
not returned. This example proves compiler provenance. It does not claim
that the optional instruction installs a new Mu. The preceding checkpoint's
blocked-construction example remains separate evidence for that behavior.

## Validation and preservation

Twelve public declaration statement/proof/standard-axiom readbacks pass.
One constructed statement/proof/standard-axiom readback passes. All eight
printer options are enabled. Only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and
`Quot.sound` are permitted. All nine selected module strict logs and the
selected example strict log are empty.

The default audit passes 3504 build jobs and 74153 axiom dependency checks.
It retains only the earlier ClosedCompletion unused-input warning.
The evidence records 62 capped Lean/Lake commands. Seventeen commands fail.
Sixteen failures are elaboration failures. One build fails before Lean
because the new source is not installed. Two successful style-warning
attempts remain unselected. Review receipt copies do not add commands.
The auxiliary identity-codec snippet has two commands and one auxiliary
public readback. It is included in command totals and excluded from the
twelve official public declarations and the constructed example count.

Every job uses the pinned Lean 4.34.1 toolchain and a verified 4 GiB memory
maximum, 4 GiB memory-high limit, zero swap and five-minute time cap.
All failed and warning attempts remain in the evidence.

All 268 Haskell files and all 207 active package files retain their bytes.
No Haskell repair or runtime validation is claimed. Root FINDINGS retains
the external Haskell repair handoff first. The optimized interned core,
older proof modules, stashes and other worktrees remain preserved.

## Remaining obligations

The evaluating owner cell is established at compiler entry. Its retention
at the optional site and final heap remains open. A captured request can
differ from its query. This result does not establish their equality.
The generated source build and rooted writer do not establish original
program binding ancestry. Global renewal, active-owner exclusion, general
outer completion, convergence and concrete Haskell refinement remain open.
The conditional root-language and Sized claims are unchanged.

Read `restart-evidence/20261020-native-optional-owner-prefix/README.md` and
`next-owner-ancestry-handoff.md` in that evidence directory before continuing.

`SourceCurrentNativeOptionalOwner.request` derives an actual captured owner
from a checked node-request prefix to the same optional instruction.

operation and rooted writer that installs a selected new full Mu cell.

that ends before that instruction does not itself supply that final check.

## Next proof target

Connect this actual capture and entered child context to original program
bindings. First inspect the existing query/capture consistency and native
shape laws. A captured request need not equal the current query in an
arbitrary machine. Supply initial cache validity and derive each needed
consistency fact through the actual query prefix. Do not assert equality
from lookup and demand alone.

entered-child trace. The receipt proves evaluating status at compiler entry.
It does not prove evaluating status at the optional site. Use the actual
shape and protected-finish laws. Do not invent an active-owner premise.

Then relate the generated `encode (leaves siteBody)` build and its rooted
writer to those original bindings. Generated value depth is not original
syntax depth. A stored body is not the current callback body. A physical
heap extension is not a completed native writer history. Keep the actual
physical, issued and native publication intervals distinct.
